title: $α'$ corrections to self-dual gravitational instantons
summary: We study the $α'$ corrections to self-dual gravitational instantons in the context of the four-dimensional Cano--Ruipérez action, which can be obtained by the compactification of the Bergshoeff--de Roo heterotic string effective action on $\mathbb{T}^{6}$ followed by a truncation and a field redefinition. We show that the metric of spaces of self-dual curvature does not receive any corrections, but their (initially trivial) dilaton and axion fields do, owing to their couplings to Gauss--Bonnet and Pontrjagin densities.
